en_title: Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 Producer Explains Why This Season's Ending Is So Different From What Fans Expected
cn_title: 《边缘行者2》制作人解读结局反差
subtitle: 悲剧也能有幸福
opus_summary: 《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》多数主角收获了某种幸福结局。制作人解释，角色即使无法战胜城市或体制，只要坚持自我、为所爱之人牺牲，也可以算是迎来了幸福结局。

paragraphs.en: We sat down with Bartosz Sztybor, the showrunner, writer, and producer for Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 , who explained the ending of the anime’s second season and why it’s so tonally different from the first.
paragraphs.cn: 我们采访了《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》的剧集统筹、编剧兼制作人Bartosz Sztybor。他解读了这部动画第二季的结局，并解释了这一季的基调为何与第一季如此不同。

paragraphs.en: Warning: Major spoilers for Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 below!
paragraphs.cn: 警告：下文涉及《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》的重大剧透！

paragraphs.en: If you’re a Cyberpunk fan, you’re likely well-acquainted with the genre’s tragic overtones. This version of the future — a version toward which we seem to be hurtling faster and faster — isn’t a happy one, and it’s no surprise; with corpo technocrats stepping on the throats of world governments and the quality of life steadily decreasing in spite of massive technological advancements, it’s difficult to find a bright spot in the grimy worlds of Neo Tokyo, futuristic Chiba, and of course, Night City.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你是赛博朋克迷，想必对这一类型的悲剧底色早已十分熟悉。这样的未来并不幸福，而我们似乎正以越来越快的速度奔向它。这也不难理解：企业技术官僚扼住各国政府的咽喉，科技虽然突飞猛进，生活质量却持续下降。在新东京、未来的千叶，当然还有夜之城这些污浊的世界里，人们很难找到一丝光亮。

paragraphs.en: This was reflected perfectly in the heart-wrenching conclusion of Edgerunners’ first season , where basically everybody died and only one person got a ‘good’ — if heart-breakingly bittersweet — ending. When Edgerunners 2 was revealed, almost everyone anticipated another tear-jerking tale that would leave them feeling hollow at the end… but they couldn’t have been more wrong.
paragraphs.cn: 《赛博朋克：边缘行者》第一季令人心碎的结局，恰好充分体现了这一点：几乎所有人都死了，只有一个人得到了「好」结局——尽管那份苦乐参半同样令人心碎。《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》公布时，几乎所有人都以为，这又会是一个催人泪下、看完后让人心里空落落的故事……但事实与他们的预想完全相反。

paragraphs.en: In a blessed turn of events, most of our main characters in Edgerunners 2 get a ‘happy’ ending of sorts. It’s definitely a stark turn from what most viewers expected, and I had to ask Sztybor why the team went in this direction when it’s a 180 from the groundwork that was previously laid in Season 1.
paragraphs.cn: 好在事情有了转机，《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》的大多数主要角色，都在某种意义上迎来了「幸福」结局。这显然与大多数观众的预期截然不同。我忍不住问Sztybor，为什么团队会选择这个方向，毕竟这与第一季此前奠定的基调完全相反。

paragraphs.en: “Cyberpunk originated from noir, and in noir, there is always a character versus the city," he explained. "The main point is that you’ll never win with the city or the system. Even for me, Season 1 is not an obvious bad ending. For me, it is somehow, a happy ending. I think in the reality of pop culture we're living in, where those happy endings that we get in a lot of movies are super sweet, and ‘they lived happily ever after’ and all that, makes us think that all the endings from Cyberpunk or Edgerunners are bad endings, but maybe they are not.
paragraphs.cn: 他解释道：「赛博朋克起源于黑色电影，而黑色电影里总有一个角色要与城市对抗。关键在于，你永远无法战胜这座城市或这套体制。即便在我看来，第一季也不是一个显而易见的坏结局。对我来说，它在某种意义上是幸福的。我觉得，在我们如今所处的流行文化环境里，很多电影的幸福结局都甜得不得了，都是那种「从此过上了幸福的生活」之类的结局。这让我们觉得，《赛博朋克》或《边缘行者》的所有结局都是坏结局，但也许并非如此。」

paragraphs.en: “‘You are not destroying the bad corporation in the end.’ Yeah, well, that's not realistic, but you saved yourself, or managed to be who you are until the end, or you made this one choice, or you sacrificed for someone who you loved. And this is also somehow a happy ending, because you managed to stay true to your character until the very end. So I think, yes, it is a tragedy, but I think both noir and Cyberpunk are just trying to, I don't know, show us what real life is."
paragraphs.cn: 「你会说，你最终并没有摧毁那家邪恶的公司。是啊，真要做到那样并不现实，但你救了自己，或是坚持做自己直到最后，或是做出了那个选择，又或是为了所爱之人而牺牲。从某种意义上说，这也是幸福结局，因为你直到最后都没有违背自己的本性。所以我觉得，没错，这是悲剧，但我认为，无论是黑色电影还是《赛博朋克》，都只是想要——我也说不准——向我们展示真实的生活是什么样的。」

paragraphs.en: Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 is out now exclusively on Netflix. You can read our review here , where we scored it a 9 out of 10, saying it “delivers the gory, action-packed goods, even if it doesn’t quite hit the highs of its predecessor.” You can also check out our previous interview with Bartosz Sztybor, who explained why we don't actually get to see that much about Roman's personal life in this season.
paragraphs.cn: 《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》现已在Netflix独家上线。你可以在这里阅读我们的评测，我们给出了9分（满分10分），并评价道，该剧「血腥场面与动作戏都足够过瘾，尽管未能完全达到前作的高度」。你也可以看看我们此前对Bartosz Sztybor的采访，他解释了为什么这一季没有过多展现Roman的私人生活。

paragraphs.en: Returning to Cyberpunk 2077 or playing it for the first time? We’ve got a new and improved Cyberpunk interactive map to help you find every mission, Iconic item, and collectible in the game. Plus, we’ve also got a full walkthrough for the base game, a Phantom Liberty walkthrough , and an overview of all the Cyberpunk 2077 endings so you don’t make a choice you regret. And we can’t ignore the various romance options you can smooch, which also impact how V’s story concludes.
paragraphs.cn: 准备重返《赛博朋克2077》，或是第一次游玩？我们全新改进的《赛博朋克》互动地图能帮你找到游戏中的每个任务、每件不朽物品和每个收集品。此外，我们还准备了本体的完整流程攻略、《往日之影》流程攻略，以及《赛博朋克2077》所有结局的概览，帮助你避免做出让自己后悔的选择。当然，也不能漏掉那些能与你亲吻的恋爱对象，这些恋爱选择也会影响V的故事如何收场。
